svg.title: Types, tests, and benchmarks cut a language model agent's distribution of next steps. Of the remaining spikes, a human picks the one that keeps the path's direction toward the goal
svg.desc: Two panels. Left ('one step inside the harness'): an incoming leap of a language model agent lands at the center of a jagged ball, pale at its center with its mass out along its spikes. The ball is the distribution of next steps that the language model and its harness induce, and each leap is one draw from it. Two corridor walls shaded as ruled out by types, tests, and benchmarks reshape the distribution: four spikes that cross the walls stop at the fence and continue only as faint dashes, where each cut spike is mass the harness removes. Three spikes survive inside the corridor, including a longer spike that turns 47 degrees upward, while the human's small red ball and pick ring select the spike that continues the incoming heading within 14 degrees, making more progress along the corridor toward the goal than the longer spike that veers off course. Right ('six steps: the human keeps up'): the agent takes six leaps along the corridor from the start dot to the goal ring, with one small red human ball and pick ring at every landing point and every turn under 12 degrees.
svg.text: six steps: the human keeps up
